{"description":"Assay of draft-barnes-mimi-identity-arch-04 (~/PROJECT/IETF/specs, sha256 314ef24a144f4594cffe3219a23759f884c34c45e1678bd2d4fc86c51890d847; latest rev, 2026-11-01).

RECOMMEND: track only, nothing to implement. Informational (L7), no BCP 14 keywords outside boilerplate; a framework (issuance / presentation / verification, §4) and a survey of instantiations (§5: manual fingerprints, X.509, VCs, SPICE). It sets no MIMI wire format or rule.

What touches mimid:
1. E2E identity is meant to protect against impersonation BY THE PROVIDER (L260-268). BasicCredential gives none: a verifying client learns only the URI string. Known gap behind mimi-protocol#159 and H1; the draft confirms it but offers no MIMI-specific answer.
2. §6 (L681ff) lists the questions interoperating parties must agree on. mimid's answers: MLS; BasicCredential with the user URI; no revocation; authority implicitly the leaf's provider. Docs bead mimid-gb5k.
3. Revocation (§4.3, L512-516): central compact CRLs authenticated by the authority, since the provider is untrusted. Relevant only with a non-Basic credential.
4. SPICE / SD-CWT as "a natural fit" (§5.4, L662-670) backs the sd-cwt track (.44.27, track only).

Spec nits (held, .37.99): [RFC633] at L480/L804 should be RFC 7633; I-D.ietf-oauth-status-list Normative (L735) but used only as an example (L522); typos L19/L121/L236/L237.

Scope: outside the draft-mahy-* rule, assayed on Mark's request 2026-11-16.
"}
Assayed; recommendation track only (no code). Follow-ups: .37.99 (held nits), mimid-gb5k (done).
